records.purpose: Nothing sends mail as tcgsouq.com yet, so every message claiming to is a forgery. -all tells receivers to reject outright.
records.revisit: Replace the moment real mail exists: Workspace becomes 'v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all'.

records.name: _dmarc
records.purpose: Reject anything failing SPF/DKIM alignment. Safe at p=reject precisely because no legitimate mail exists yet - there is nothing to break.
records.revisit: When mail starts: drop to p=none, add rua=mailto:dmarc@tcgsouq.com, read reports for two weeks, then climb back to reject. rua MUST be an address on tcgsouq.com - an external mailbox needs an authorisation record on ITS domain (RFC 7489 s7.1), which we cannot publish on gmail.com.

records.blocked_on: Email decision (docs/domain/README.md, decision D3). A null MX says 'this domain receives no mail' - correct only if we do NOT enable Porkbun forwarding or Workspace.
records.purpose: RFC 7505 null MX: bounce mail to tcgsouq.com immediately instead of letting senders retry for days.

records.name: codex
records.blocked_on: Add codex.tcgsouq.com as a domain on the Vercel project tcgsouq-codex FIRST. DNS pointed at Vercel for a domain Vercel does not know about serves a 404 and issues no certificate.
records.purpose: Codex curation app, today on tcgsouq-codex.vercel.app.

records.name: hub

records.purpose: WhatsApp inbox PWA. Its own subdomain rather than hub/chat - see docs/domain/README.md, decision D2.

records.name: go

records.purpose: Short-link redirector for UTM'd links in posts and broadcasts.
